summary: This bill requires federal agencies to analyze the impact of proposed major rules on individuals living in poverty and on racial inequity, and mandates annual Government Accountability Office reports on the impact of federal programs and policies on these same issues.

scores.thoughts: This bill requires agencies to analyze the impact of major rules on individuals living at, near, or below the poverty line, and the GAO to report on the impact of government programs or policies on poverty. This directly relates to understanding and potentially expanding the social safety net, as it focuses on the well-being of low-income individuals.
